The opponent seat plays member (match seed mod n) (strat-run.lisp: a comma list in STRAT_P<n>). Paths relative to this directory; none = the opponent's shipped CPU with no strategy at all (BRAIN-STRAT NIL). The online/ken-*.lisp proxies (8.14) carry no character: under a :fn only :range acts, so they play the same for any character. No KI style CPU exists for Hisagi (only cpu-ki-ken, cpu-ki-ichigo).
